title: ASARS Telecom-SLA Profile v0.1-draft
description: ASARS payload extension for 5G SLA verification, C-V2X, and URLLC-oriented edge measurements. Draft profile co-developed with Attesta Edgeflow for experiment-driven receipts (including Curiosity Lab deployments). Not for production until reviewed against live RAN and core network telemetry.

experiment_id.description: Identifier linking this receipt to a lab or field experiment (e.g. Curiosity_lab run).

network_slice_id.description: Logical network slice or tenant slice identifier, if applicable.

gnb_id.description: gNodeB or edge site identifier, if applicable.

latency_ms.description: Observed one-way or round-trip latency in milliseconds, semantics defined by the observer.

jitter_ms.description: Observed jitter in milliseconds, semantics defined by the observer.

packet_or_frame_loss_ppm.description: Loss rate in parts per million (or equivalent), semantics defined by the observer.

sla_threshold_breach.description: Whether the observation crossed a configured SLA threshold at receipt time.

outcome.description: Whether the underlying action or datapath state was allowed or blocked by policy or enforcement.

notes: Co-development target: Attesta Edgeflow architecture and empirical data from Curiosity Lab. Replace placeholder KPI fields with types and units agreed with RAN/core subject-matter experts before marking a non-draft revision.
